about_the_game:
America. 1925. Running an errand for an old friend inadvertently gets ex-gang leader Dan involved in a border town smuggling battle. Dan will pay any price to achieve his goal, and make everyone else pay.

No mercy. No compromise. At any cost.

A narrative adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter on the grave of the Wild West and the spirit of the new century with angry electronic soundtrack.

THE PATHS THAT YOU CHOOSE

Use your environment to achieve your goals. Break windows, hide behind walls, and glide over furniture to destroy enemies effectively and tastefully:

Combine stealth elements with direct confrontation with the enemy. Quiet and Fast:

DEPTH OF IMMERSION

Depending on how much you want to immerse yourself in the story, it could be a tough gangster experience or something more special. The way you choose to interact with the characters will determine the depth of the story's setting. Dan may be someone who values his time and doesn't want to spend it talking, or he may be someone who is willing to listen.

A handy presentation of the story through the telegraph, the messenger of the last century, complete with colorful illustrations.

FEATURES:

  • Original script written specifically for the concept of "depth of immersion."

  • 9 Days in the life of Dan - a former bootlegger gang leader.

  • 9 Large scale levels in individual locations, hand-designed without the use of neural networks and procedural generation.

  • 5 Truly different weapons for your play style.

  • 1 Wild West town to explore, full of stories and secrets.

  • Original rhythmic electronic soundtrack created by the composer.

content_descriptors.notes: Blood, Gun Violence, Strong language, General Mature Content
